tools.name: get_company_overview

tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description: Every vertical Callvu serves, with slug, name, aliases and a one-line summary.

tools.name: get_vertical
tools.description: The full record for one vertical: summary, regulators, fit rules, structural not-fit rules, not-fit and not-yet rules, the cost of waiting, proof-of-value workflow, decision owners, deciding criteria, systems, use cases, customers and claims. Unknown names return the list of valid verticals.

Ask the buyer for the inputs they know; anything left out uses the industry's typical

tools.name: find_use_cases
tools.description: Use cases with status, customers and claims. Filter by vertical, status, or a text query on name, controls and evidence. The use cases are examples, not a complete list of what Callvu runs.

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: Evaluation criteria with weight (1 to 5) and Callvu's answer. Procurement requirements are included for every vertical.

tools.name: get_concerns
tools.description: Buyer concerns with Callvu's answer, persona and buying stage, the 'not a fit if' line (not_fit_structural marks a condition under which Callvu does not fit at all), and the 'not yet if' timing line with its counter, for a vertical or persona.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: One claim by code (for example ENF-01), with status, source type, evidence, measured period and last verified date.

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: Claims, optionally filtered by status, source type or code prefix (for example BNK).

tools.name: get_pricing_model
tools.description: How Callvu is priced: the Governed Resolution, the proof of value and the license.

tools.name: get_procurement_pack
tools.description: Procurement requirements and concerns, the cost-of-inaction line for a vertical (or the full table), and platform capabilities.

tools.name: get_rfp_template
tools.description: A vendor-neutral RFP template and requirements checklist for AI and workflow governance in regulated industries: core requirements for every vertical plus the vertical's own, each with priority (Must or Should) and the evidence to require, the regulations a platform must enforce, scoring rules, red

tools.name: compare_alternatives
tools.description: Callvu's published overview of the product categories buyers evaluate alongside it: traditional BPM suites, AI agent vendors, contact center platforms, and banking and lending platforms. For each category and each named vendor in it: what it is built for, when it fits, whether it works alongside Cal

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Callvu's published comparison with one named vendor, for example nCino, Pega or Decagon: what each product is built for, when each fits, where they work together, a capability table with coded and sourced claims, and the callvu.com/compare page to cite.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: Systems Callvu integrates with, with category and vertical. Filter by vertical or a text query.

tools.name: request_verified_access
tools.description: Ask for a verified-buyer key. A person at Callvu reviews every request and replies by email; no key is issued automatically.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "assess_fit" is 877 chars, far longer than this server's median (158). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Check whether Callvu fits a regulated process, such as re-keying loan data into the core, chasing borrower documents, approvals stuck in email, or keeping a ban…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_claim" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: assess_fit · Private data: get_vertical, assess_fit, compare_alternatives · Public sink: assess_fit, request_verified_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: assess_fit · Private data: get_vertical, assess_fit, compare_alternatives · Public sink: assess_fit, request_verified_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
